_source: ResourceGraphCommon.ErrorResponse (https://learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/azureresourcegraph/resourcegraph/resources/resources?view=rest-azureresourcegraph-resourcegraph-2024-04-01#resourcegraphcommon.errorresponse) for throttling, with the headers of https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/governance/resource-graph/concepts/guidance-for-throttled-requests. The test sends it with Retry-After, x-ms-user-quota-remaining: 0 and x-ms-user-quota-resets-after: 00:00:05. The text is illustrative, not recorded from a tenant.
